rows.value: Deliveries rose for the third quarter in a row while fuel use fell, helped by the two electric vans added at the South depot in August. On-time performance improved in every region except Central, where road works on the ring road added an average of nine minutes to afternoon routes. Next quarter the focus moves to load planning at the East depot.

rows.value: The East region again completed the most deliveries, and the West region recovered from a slow second quarter. Central is the only region where the on-time rate fell; the delay is concentrated between 2 pm and 5 pm and is expected to ease when the road works finish in November.

rows.value: Fuel use per 100 km fell from 31.4 litres in January to 27.9 litres in September. Most of the improvement came after route re-planning in April and the electric vans in August, which now cover the shortest urban routes.
